newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indorayon says Q1 net at 7.5 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Indorayon says Q1 net at 7.5 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian pulp and rayon maker PT Inti Indorayon Utama said on Friday it posted a net profit of 7.5 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997 against a loss of 16.21 billion rupiah in the year-ago period.
Indorayon said in a statement it posted net sales of 117.9 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997 against 75.3 billion rupiah in the year-ago period.
The company posted a profit in the first quarter due to an improvement in demand for pulp, which enabled the company to sell inventories built up in late 1996, it said.
Indorayon had increased its pulp paper price to $450 per tonne starting May 1 due to the higher demand, the firm said. It did not give the previous price.
The firm said it was in talks with Finland-based chemicals and fertiliser group Kemira Oy over a plan to acquire Kemira's viscose fibres unit Kemira Fibres.
Indorayon said it also planned to acquire a chemical plant in Kerinci, Sumatra. The firm did not give further details.
